description: Jam Arom is a noodle shop in Mae Chaem town, recommended as a food stop on the Mae Hong Son Loop. Its wooden setting and tom yum-style noodles offer a simple meal in the valley beyond Doi Inthanon. The marker identifies the named restaurant near the municipal office in Chang Khoeng.

address: 24 Charoen Prathet Road Soi 1, Chang Khlan, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand

name: Wat Pa Daet — Mae Chaem
address: Moo 4, Tha Pha, Mae Chaem, Chiang Mai 50270, Thailand
description: Wat Pa Daet is a temple in Tha Pha, Mae Chaem, known for the mural paintings inside its viharn. The scenes combine Buddhist stories and local tales with details of farming, clothing and everyday life in the Mae Chaem valley. A separate scripture library houses Buddhist texts and palm leaf manuscripts, adding another layer to a visit focused on local art and heritage.
